body.p: In the Platform BIOS Firmware Architecture Specification, "Nova Lake Boot and Reset Flow" chapter describes SOC rest flow and multiple reset phases.
Due to hybrid architecture and various firmware handshake protocols, certain BIOS configurations require a cold reset for changes to take effect:

ul.li:
CPU Early Power-On Configuration Register (EPOC/EPOC2)
CDie Enabled Mask
GDie Enabled Mask

CPU Soft Strap Data
Number of active P-cores
Number of active E-cores
HT Enable/Disable
